contract.fault_ceiling_scope: 6.4 A is the full-tolerance non-fault ceiling; fault transients require separate maximum waveform, clamp, SOA and I2t proof.
contract.limiter_requirement: Exact limiter guaranteed at 6.000–6.400 A over full tolerance and temperature with hot resistance <=57 mOhm.
contract.prior_limiter_disposition: MAX17527AATP+T with 6.25 kOhm is REJECTED as production current-contract basis because its guaranteed minimum is 5.754245754 A.

gates.evidence: HPQ4 v2.0 rejects MAX17527AATP+T/6.25 kOhm as production current-contract basis.
gates.requirement: Exact production limiter must be selected before the nFET actual gate-drive and fault timing can be bound.

gates.evidence: STL125N10LF8AG has 5.8 mOhm max at 4.5 V, 25 C; actual MAX minimum is 4.45 V; hot curve is typical. No candidate has guaranteed 4.45 V hot max.
gates.requirement: Guaranteed RDS(on) <=15.625 mOhm hot at the actual minimum gate drive over tolerance and temperature.
gates.resume: Replacement limiter gate-drive contract plus manufacturer guarantee or bounded production qualification.

gates.evidence: STL125N10LF8AG is 100 V; PiSXMe negative-input/harness/TVS transient envelope is not bound by HPQ4. Headline VDS alone is insufficient.
gates.requirement: VDS margin for source, reverse-polarity and transient envelope.

gates.evidence: Only a legacy MAX17527A illustrative screen exists: 32 A^2*3 us = 0.003072 A^2s and 15.625 mOhm at that current would dissipate 48 uJ under a constant-current simplification. It omits inductive/clamp/fuse trajectories and is not a closure proof.
gates.requirement: Six-loop fast-fault waveform against nFET SOA/I2t, TVS pulse, fuse clearing and PCB copper.
gates.resume: Exact limiter, fuse, TVS, harness L/R and copper values with worst-case waveform calculation.

gates.evidence: MAX17527A public datasheet describes external FET control and typical 108 ns/17 us reverse-current responses, but that controller is rejected as production basis and its values are not a system guarantee.
gates.requirement: Reverse-current and reverse-polarity behavior for the selected limiter/FET pair.
gates.resume: Exact limiter reverse-current thresholds/timing and FET VDS/body-diode/turn-off proof.

gates.evidence: ST gives RthJC 1 C/W and RthJA 162 C/W on a reference board; PiSXMe installation, copper, ambient and airflow are unqualified.
gates.requirement: Installed package/copper/airflow keeps FET junction and protected path within limits.
gates.resume: MPA/Thermal installation authority and protected-copper extraction.

gates.evidence: HPQ4 requires six independent loops and no passive sharing; current source implementation has not bound six production paths or fail-safe aggregation.
gates.requirement: Six independent fault paths, FLAG/inhibit/reset behavior and no masking.
gates.resume: System/Power Authority fault truth table and implementation candidate.

limitations: No gate-drive or SOA/I2t claim is made for production.
No vendor approval, measurement, fabricated-hardware validation, or CAD authorization is claimed.
The legacy MAX17527A timing values are retained only as an explanatory non-production screen.
recommended_next_action: Power Authority selects a replacement limiter satisfying HPQ4, then requalifies the exact nFET against that limiter actual gate drive and worst-case fault waveform.
